title: How AI agents think for themselves #AI #technology
description: Ever wondered what AI agents are? This video explains them for non-technical people, showing how these large language models manage themselves through internal conversations. Discover practical applications for these ai tools, like 'claude agents' and Copilot, and see how they can perform tasks autonomously. It's a look into 'chatgpt agent mode' and how an 'ai assistant' can work for you.
